text.lead: Indigo Children is a 2012 American drama film about the romance between two teenagers based on the concept of the existence of indigo children, who allegedly possess special faculties. Directed by Eric Chaney, this film was inspired by the first girl he ever loved.
text.plot: The movie shows a relationship of two teenagers in suburban New Jersey, who over the duration of summer develop their romance and explore their alleged cryptic psychic abilities.
text.cast:
- Robert Olsen as Mark
- Isabelle McNally as Christina
- Christine Donlon as Jenny
